name: Suas sa Spéir (Height for Hire) by Tatyana Feeney

pages.title: Suas sa Spéir | Height for Hire : a book without words - My Irish Books
pages.description: Sa scéal mealltach seo gan fhocail, éiríonn le buachaill teacht ar réiteach neamhghnách... le cabhair ó chara sna harda.  In this enchanting story without words, a boy finds an unusual solution... with the help of a friend from upon high.     “When I open a book by Tatyana, it’s like stepping into a child’s daydream. Anything and everything is possible. There’s no place for adult logic, but every inner child is welcomed.” Brian Fitzgerald
